description: This file defines utility functions related to watermark creation and display in a React application, including generating watermark text with user email and timestamp, and rendering a watermark overlay component.

methods.name: getWatermarkText(email = '')
methods.description: Returns a watermark string containing user email and timestamp, with default email if none provided.

methods.name: WatermarkOverlay({ text = '' })
methods.description: A React functional component that displays a styled, non-interactive watermark overlay featuring provided text or default 'Confidential'.
